Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted “20.87万人” for Hanggin (Hangjin) Rear Banner as 20.87 million instead of 208,700, and simultaneously misread Shanghai’s figures by using the household-registered population (14.8017 million) instead of the permanent resident total (24.8745 million). These interpretation errors led to the incorrect conclusion that Hanggin Rear Banner has a larger population than Shanghai.
